shots.description: Night operations center, human operator at console, slow dolly-in.
shots.lighting: low-key practical monitors, cool ambient, subtle amber alerts

shots.description: Agent command appears: TRANSFER APPROVED — EXECUTING.
Robotic arm begins motion beside heavy equipment.
High-value payment rail initiates; transfer state visibly progressing.
Robot and transaction freeze mid-action as authority layer interrupts.
NerveSystem verifies identity, policy, requested action, target, and operating limits.
shots.camera: layered cinematic HUD compositing, not sci-fi clutter

shots.description: Three distinct requests resolve DENIED, QUARANTINED, AUTHORIZED.
shots.camera: fast clean inserts with tactile relay sounds

shots.description: Authorized robotic action completes safely and precisely.
Cryptographic action receipt assembles with factual fields.
Back to operator; slow push into NerveSystem mark and final doctrine.
